title: A palace built in layers
text: City Palace grew through the work of successive Mewar rulers rather than a single building campaign. Its courtyards and balconies sit above Lake Pichola, connecting royal architecture to the water below. Read the complex as a sequence of additions: a doorway, a court, then another view of the lake.

title: Courtyards and changing viewpoints
text: A palace courtyard is a pause between enclosed rooms and open views. At City Palace, moving from one space to another makes the complex easier to read than trying to absorb the entire facade at once. Look for how balconies and passageways frame the lake, rather than treating each room as an isolated exhibit.
